name: Sticky Arcade
summary: Play 17 touch games and read DRM-free EPUB books offline on reTerminal Sticky.
description: Sticky Arcade is a native offline launcher for reTerminal Sticky with 17 touch games and a read-only microSD browser for DRM-free, reflowable EPUB 2/3 books. Games preserve their state across launcher visits and deep sleep, and the interface supports English, Spanish, French, German, and Simplified Chinese.

compatibility.notes: The exact v2.0.0 merged release image was built, flashed, and used successfully on connected reTerminal E1005 hardware.

assets.previewAlt: First Sticky Arcade selector page captured from a reTerminal E1005

notes.title: Device connection
notes.description: Connect reTerminal Sticky with a USB data cable and use desktop Chrome or Edge.

notes.title: Clean installation
notes.description: Erase the device when installing Sticky Arcade over another firmware. The package writes one complete 32 MB ESP32-S3 merged image from flash offset 0.

notes.title: First boot
notes.description: Choose English, Spanish, French, German, or Simplified Chinese. The language can be changed later from the selector settings cog.

notes.title: Offline use
notes.description: All 17 games run offline. Insert a microSD card only when browsing and reading supported DRM-free EPUB 2/3 books.
